RETAIN_CANONICAL_AUTHORITY. Registry canonical project export: the same 100 in a different text format and order. Logical hash = registry baseline (lh1:7359723b...). Current, not stale.

LOCAL_BEST_IN_TESTED_POOL_RESEARCH_ONLY (two genuine swaps, below the five-swap floor; NOT owner-presentable; J bundle blocked by the existing Stage A seal mismatch): +Court of Vantress -Cruel Reality (Court copies an enchantment or artifact each upkeep while you are monarch; token Curse copies are attached to a player of your choice under CR 303.4f and can be attached to you for Lynde to move; Cruel Reality returned to you by Lynde costs a creature or planeswalker each upkeep: grid B1 Lynde herself is the only legal sacrifice in 42/96 Cruel Reality cells, removal grid B4 self-harm 6/12) and +Extravagant Replication -Curse of Death's Hold (Replication copies a nonland permanent each upkeep; Death's Hold returned to you shrinks your creatures and kills the X/1 Nightscape Familiar in 32/96 B1 cells). Neither cut is an explicit owner keep or owner add. Extra-upkeep supply grid B3: Lynde draws 82 -> 204 and Curse tokens 0 -> 102 per engine over 36 cells. Goldfish P(Lynde cast) turn 7 0.8681 unchanged; P(Lynde + copy engine) 0.1381 versus P(Lynde + the cut Curses) 0.1051. Costs: EDHREC adoption favours the cuts (Cruel Reality 5703/7774, Death's Hold 5548/7774 versus Court 1705/7774, Replication 2712/7774), Court's value stops when the monarchy is lost, and both adds are slower (5 and 6 mana) than an immediate symmetrical lock. Spellbook included combos 0 -> 0; Game Changers 8 -> 8; lands 35 -> 35; Bracket 4 unchanged. Confidence MODERATE.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (staged; complete 100 that keeps every owner keep and owner add). Only +Court of Vantress -Cruel Reality; keeps Curse of Death's Hold. Goldfish P(Lynde + copy engine) turn 7 0.0858. Provided as the smaller step if the owner values Death's Hold as an anti-token lock.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (staged; complete 100 that keeps every owner keep and owner add). Only +Extravagant Replication -Curse of Death's Hold; keeps Cruel Reality. Goldfish P(Lynde + copy engine) turn 7 0.0568. Provided if the owner values Cruel Reality's lock more than its self-harm risk.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (staged; not counted). Staff of Compleation can destroy a permanent you own (a Curse attached to an opponent) for {1} and 1 life: goldfish P(Lynde + repeatable outlet) turn 7 0.2716 -> 0.3379, but losing Nightscape Familiar's cost reduction lowers P(Lynde cast) turn 4 0.629 -> 0.6179 and turn 7 0.8681 -> 0.8601. A trade, not a clear gain; owner choice.

REJECT (compare-only). Curse of Chaos was removed by the owner on 2026-10-14 (replaced by Curse of Hospitality) and Curse of Echoes is an explicit owner add, so re-adding Chaos would reverse an owner decision; no measured advantage (goldfish equals the candidate; the model does not score Curse text).

REJECT (compare-only). Strionic Resonator was explicitly rejected by the owner on 2026-10-14 (repeated mana, does not beat direct engines). Copying Lynde's upkeep trigger only adds a draw-two when a second Curse is attached to you; it costs Nightscape's reduction (P(Lynde cast) turn 7 0.8601). Spellbook almost-included 22 -> 24, included 0 -> 0.

REJECT (compare-only). Beseech the Mirror was explicitly rejected by the owner on 2026-10-14 (no slot weaker enough); bargaining a Curse triggers Lynde, but the deck already has Curse of Misfortunes, Demonic/Vampiric Tutor and Imperial Seal, and Curse of the Restless Dead is a cheap three-mana Curse that makes a decayed Zombie whenever the cursed player's land enters (5901/7774).

REJECT. Disturbing Mirth (118/7774 Lynde decks) is a real one-shot outlet: on entry you may sacrifice a Curse, draw two and have Lynde return it. But it is not repeatable, needs a Curse already on the battlefield, and the deck already has Perilous Research, Despotic Scepter, Claws of Gix, Braids and Demon of Fate's Design. Trespasser's Curse (7118/7774) is a premium Curse for Lynde to move around.

REJECT. Teferi's Ageless Insight doubles Lynde's draws but is a 4-mana non-Curse card with no table impact and is absent from Lynde's general/upgraded/optimized pages (2 of 3 cEDH decks only); Curse of Unbinding is the deck's free-card upkeep engine (6845/7774). Spellbook almost-included 22 -> 23.
REJECT. Thoughtrender Lamia is a 6-mana constellation discard payoff; Bitterheart Witch (6185/7774) tutors a Curse onto the battlefield when it dies and feeds the engine.
REJECT. Curse of the Bloody Tome is a weak mill Curse (the owner removed Fraying Sanity because the deck has no mill plan); Maddening Hex (6292/7774) deals repeated damage and moves itself.
